sources.snippet: A from-scratch, pure-CUDA inference engine and OpenAI-compatible server for 0xSero/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-REAP: DeepSeek-V4-Flash pruned to 160 routed experts, with native MXFP4 experts. It runs on one NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor (sm_110a), serves a single agentic session at a time, and decodes losslessly with a fine-tuned DSpark speculative draft head at 28.4 tok/s.
